Class ItemChoiceController

java.lang.Object
controllers.Controller<ItemsView>
controllers.fight.ItemChoiceController
public class ItemChoiceController extends Controller<ItemsView>
Controller for the item selection sub-view used during a fight.

This controller initializes the ItemsView, provides it with the list of available items, and handles user actions coming from the sub-view. It delegates the selected item through a callback and closes the sub-window when the interaction is complete.
